brightness_module.sites: two encoder sites + bottom site + two decoder sites
brightness_module.attention: main Q; shared-pyramid prior K,V; independent channel cross-attention + 2xFFN at five sites
brightness_module.pyramid: four maps once; existing half16 and bottom96; new full4/16/24 and half16/48 projections
brightness_module.precision: FP32 fixed maps, Q/K normalization and scores; AMP encoder/projections/FFN
brightness_module.supervision: low RGB after augmentation only; GT only in the final GT-Mean loss

training.image_policy: paired random crop 192x384, horizontal/vertical flip each p=0.5; val/infer whole image

test.note: Training was still running when this branch was uploaded; val best and test four metrics will be added after completion.
